visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A petite young woman with short brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt and pink backpack, is walking down a concrete staircase inside a building. She reaches the bottom and exaggeratedly ducks her head under a sign that reads 小心碰頭 (Watch your head), even though she is clearly much shorter than the low ceiling. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor room where the girl is reaching up toward a shelf. A significantly taller person stands behind her and places their hand flat on top of her head to emphasize the height difference. She looks up with a playful, frustrated expression. (3) She is seen standing in a brightly lit cafe or flower shop next to a taller female friend. Both women are holding large, colorful bouquets of blue and pink flowers. They smile at the camera, showing a clear height gap. (4) In a modern clothing retail store with bright overhead lighting, she holds up a long tan-colored dress against her frame. The dress is so long it touches the floor, making it look like a gown on her. (5) Inside a gym with mirrored walls, the girl stands in front of a very tall, muscular man. She looks up at him while gesturing with her hands as if arguing, emphasizing the comedic scale of their height difference. (6) At night, outdoors under a bridge or structure, she poses with another tall friend. Both wear jackets and make peace signs for a photo. (7) She is seen in a traditional market stall, waving cheerfully at the camera with a bright smile. (8) She lies flat on green grass in a park next to a crocodile, comparing her body length to the animal's length. (9) Finally, she is in a swimming pool sitting on a small inflatable unicorn floaty. Next to her is a giant, oversized unicorn floaty that towers over her. She laughs and splashes in the water.
